admin_panel:
🎛️ ADMIN PANEL — Komara Agency 🇬🇳
Your whole bot, from your phone 👇

💰 MONEY & REPORTS
📊 /stats — counters + money (quotes, month, orders)
📈 /rapport — full report
🗓️ /hebdo — weekly report
📤 /export — data export

👥 CLIENTS & SALES
📞 /prend — your 10 latest clients + numbers
👤 /prend <name> — full client card
✉️ /msg <id|number> <text> — message a client via the bot
📢 /broadcast <text> — promo to all clients
🛒 /commandes — catalogue orders
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 /clients — client list
📅 /rdvs — appointments

🛍️ CATALOGUE & PROMOS
📦 /produit — product list
➕ /produit add <cat>|<name>|<desc>|<price>
💱 /produit maj <id>|<price> — change a price
❌ /produit del <id> — remove a product
🎟️ /promo CODE 20 [max] — create a code (e.g. /promo TABASKI20 20 = -20%)
🚫 /promo off CODE — deactivate a code
📋 /promos — active codes

🤖 BOT CONTROL
🔒 /pause — close the bot (clients get the closed message)
✅ /reprend — reopen the bot
🔄 /maj — reload the knowledge base
📄 /facture — PDF invoice
💾 /backup — manual Drive backup
🔗 /google — Google connection
📥 /kb_import — import entries

💡 Winning combo: /prend to see a client, /msg to write to them, /broadcast for a general promo. Only your ID can run all of this 🔐
